records.body:
[P3] Stack Exchange API key sent as X-API-Key header the SE API ignores

The adapter transmits the credential as an `X-API-Key` request header (engines/stackexchange.py line 64: `request_headers["X-API-Key"] = api_key`), but the Stack Exchange 2.3 API expects the app key as a `key` query parameter. A reader who sets `ENGINE_STACKEXCHANGE_API_KEY` following this newly documented row gets no quota or auth benefit because the key is sent in a header the upstream API does not honor. Fix: append `&key=<api_key>` to the search URL when a key is present, or soften the doc wording to note the key is not currently applied.
